items.name: calendar-heatmap
items.title: CalendarHeatmap
items.description: GitHub-contributions-style activity heatmap, in squares or check-in dots.

items.title: Card
items.description: The elevated surface primitive, with header, title, description, content, and footer slots.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: CheckboxGroup
items.description: Pick-any tile grid: the multi-select counterpart to ToggleGroup.

items.title: ColorInput

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: ConfirmButton
items.description: Tap-again-to-confirm destructive button, with the armed state announced to assistive tech.

items.name: drawer-action
items.title: DrawerAction
items.description: A single action in a BottomDrawer footer: plain, form-submit, or tap-again-confirm.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState

items.name: input
items.title: Input

items.title: Notice

items.name: use-tab-bar-fade
items.title: useTabBarFade
items.description: Edge-fade masks for a horizontally overflowing tab strip; returns the CSS class to apply.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme
items.description: The theme engine: light, dark, system, and OLED, with persistence and theme-color meta kept in sync.

items.title: cn
